options.name: api_key
options.description: Mattermost webhook API key. Log into your Mattermost site, go to Menu -> Integration -> Incoming Webhook -> Add Incoming Webhook. This gives you a full URL. O(api_key) is the last part. U(http://mattermost.example.com/hooks/API_KEY).

options.name: attachments
options.description: Define a list of attachments. For more information, see U(https://developers.mattermost.com/integrate/admin-guide/admin-message-attachments/). Required when O(text) is not set.

options.name: channel
options.description: Channel to send the message to. If absent, the message goes to the channel selected for the O(api_key).

options.name: icon_url
options.description: URL for the message sender's icon.

options.name: priority
options.description: Set a priority for the message.

options.name: text
options.description: Text to send. Note that the module does not handle escaping characters. Required when O(attachments) is not set.

options.name: username
options.description: This is the sender of the message (Username Override need to be enabled by mattermost admin, see mattermost doc).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
